title: October 29, 2018: India rolled out a train with no engine, built in just 18 months. It's now the country's fastest.

sources.text: The Quint (PTI) - Train 18, Country's First Engine-less Train, Rolled Out

caption:
October 29, 2018: India rolled out a train with no engine, built in just 18 months. It's now the country's fastest.

Nicknamed "Train 18" for its 18-month build time, the Rs 100 crore prototype was designed and built domestically - a break from India's long reliance on imported rolling stock.

Built to replace the Shatabdi Express on key routes, it proved a domestically-engineered train could outperform the imported standard it was meant to succeed.

Train 18's 18-month build-to-rollout timeline became the template for a rail manufacturing program that's since multiplied Vande Bharat routes across the country.
